title: This 8 hour tour with a...
text: This 8 hour tour with a private car, driver and guide was the perfect way to experience the beauty of Barcelona in a single day. Our guide Isabel has been a licensed guide for many years and she is very knowledgeable. Breakfast and lunch and all tickets were included in the price. It was a magical experience.

title: I highly recommend Xavier and the tour in general.
text: Xavier was absolutely fantastic!  So knowledgeable about Barcelona history and in general.   I highly recommend him and would request him again

title: One day private tour in Barcelona
text:
This one day private tour of Barcelona was wonderful. 
Our guide, Xavi, was a very good guide, explaining the main points of the places we visited in a very short time.

If I come back to Barcelona again, I would definitely appoint him.
author: keijiw2025

title: Fabulous Tour with Hotel Pick Up
text: We originally signed up for the tour of Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia that picked up up at hotel but there were not enough signed up.  They offered us a private tour for a 20% discount and it was the best choice we have ever made!  Our guide, Montse Marques, was fabulous.  We got so many extra little perks with the private tour -a coffee stop with pastry, a lunch, and all ticket prices includes.  She was the most informed guide ever and pointed out so many interesting things taht we had missed the day before when we were just walking around on our own.  The communication with We Are Guides
author: Farmerkid

title: Great tour !
text: We enjoyed the private tour. We beat the larger groups and were able to move at our own pace. We especially enjoyed learning about the amazing history.
author: KOLAR602

title: Absolutely amazing
text: Gloria and the driver were amazing. Gloria was knowledgeable, fun and informative. She showed us everything and explained everything Well. The driver was courteous, professional, and on time every time  All our needs were taken care of. It was just an amazing day.
author: Theresa_C

title: The BEST Way to See Barcelona!
text: The Private Barcelona Tour was THE way to visit the “must see” sites in the city. Miguel (our guide) and Ivan (our driver) did an amazing job sharing their love and knowledge of the city with our family of five. It was a perfect blend of walking and riding from spot to spot. Skip the lines with included tickets to sold out tourist sites. We stopped for pastries and coffee in the morning and a delicious jamon, bread and wine lunch - both included in the cost of the tour. It was a perfect day. Thank you guys!!
author: E299COsusanc

title: Had a great tour, of major sites of Barcelona.
text: We had a really nice day with Anna.  She was very knowledgeable about each of the sites we visited. The conversations were relaxed and informative.  We really enjoyed the day.
